arXiv:2606.23617v1 [cs.RO] 2026 年 6 月 22 日arXiv:2606.23617v1 [cs.RO] 22 Jun 2026

回忆：视觉-语言-行动模型中主动终身学习的恢复经验收集RECALL: Recovery Experience Collection for Active Lifelong Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models

Ulas Berk Karli
Department of Computer Science
Yale University United States
ulasberk.karli@yale.edu
&Tesca Fitzgerald
Department of Computer Science
Yale University United States
tesca.fitzgerald@yale.edu
摘要Abstract

视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通常通过被动模仿学习进行微调，其中针对策略表现不佳的任务收集额外的演示。这种方法有几个缺点：它要求机器人在触发数据收集之前失败，几乎没有提供关于哪些状态需要监督的指导，并且在政策已经表现良好的任务的冗余部分上浪费了演示者的精力。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对 VLA 的主动、持续学习范例。我们证明，与使用被动收集的演示相比，主动的、不确定性引导的数据收集可以带来更有效的微调。然而，我们还发现，仅对主动收集的恢复数据进行微调会导致灾难性的遗忘。我们评估持续学习的技术，包括基于重放的数据混合和弹性权重合并，并确定可塑性与不确定性引导的恢复数据和保留先前学习的行为之间的权衡。总体而言，我们的工作对自回归 VLA 的主动持续学习进行了实证研究，确定了不确定性引导的恢复演示可以提高适应效率，同时也揭示了将有针对性的新数据纳入大型机器人策略时面临的挑战。Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly fine-tuned through passive imitation learning, where additional demonstrations are collected for tasks where the policy performs poorly. This approach incurs several downsides: it requires the robot to fail before data collection is triggered, provides little guidance about which states require supervision, and wastes demonstrator effort on redundant parts of the task where the policy already performs well. In this paper, we propose an active, continual learning paradigm for VLAs. We demonstrate that active, uncertainty-guided data collection leads to more efficient fine-tuning than when using passively-collected demonstrations. However, we also find that fine-tuning only on actively-collected recovery data leads to catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate techniques for continual learning, including replay-based data mixing and elastic weight consolidation, and identify tradeoffs between plasticity to uncertainty-guided recovery data and retention of previously learned behaviors. Overall, our work contributes an empirical study of active continual learning for autoregressive VLAs, establishing that uncertainty-guided recovery demonstrations can improve adaptation efficiency while also revealing open challenges when targeted new data is incorporated into large robot policies.

关键词：Keywords:VLA 型号；主动学习；持续学习VLA Models; Active Learning; Continual Learning

1 简介Introduction

最近的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，例如 RT-1Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models such as RT-1[1], RT-2 [2], 双子座机器人, Gemini Robotics[3], π0\pi_{0}-快速-FAST[4], 和, andπ0.5\pi_{0.5} [5]已经表明，大规模机器人学习可以产生广泛能力的操纵策略。然而，尽管 VLA 具有普遍性，但在部署到新的机器人、环境或任务分配时仍然需要进行微调。在实践中，这种适应通常是通过被动模仿学习来执行的，其中专家（i）从任务初始状态开始收集额外的演示，（ii）微调模型，（iii）评估性能，以及（iv）如果策略仍然不可靠则重复。 由于多种原因，该过程效率低下。首先，它仅表明模型在发生故障后需要更多数据，这可能既耗时又不安全。其次，它几乎没有提供关于需要多少额外数据的指导，这可能导致数据收集不足或过度。第三，被动回忆并不能确定监督在哪里最有用。因此，示威者可能会将大部分精力花在原始训练数据中已经得到很好体现的状态上；然而，失败可能是由一小组困难的子步骤或从分布转移的中间状态的恢复引起的。have shown that large-scale robot learning can produce broadly capable manipulation policies. However, despite their generality, VLAs still require fine-tuning when deployed to new robots, environments, or task distributions. In practice, this adaptation is usually performed through passive imitation learning, where an expert (i) collects additional demonstrations starting from task initial states, (ii) fine-tunes the model, (iii) evaluates performance, and (iv) repeats if the policy remains unreliable. This process is inefficient for several reasons. First, it only reveals that the model needs more data after failures occurred, which can be time-consuming and unsafe. Second, it gives little guidance about how much additional data is needed, which can lead to under- or over-collection of data. Third, passive recollection does not identify where supervision would be most useful. Demonstrators may therefore spend most of their efforts on states that are already well represented in the original training data; yet, failures may arise from a small set of difficult substeps or recovery from distribution-shifted intermediate states.

我们提出了一种主动、持续的学习范式来微调 VLA。我们的中心假设是，与典型的被动数据收集相比，从高不确定性状态收集演示将带来更多信息（因此更高效）的数据收集。我们使用最先进的技术进行不确定性量化We propose an active, continual learning paradigm for fine-tuning VLAs. Our central hypothesis is that collecting demonstrations from high-uncertainty states will lead to more informative (and thus, efficient) data collection compared to typical passive data collection. We use a state-of-the-art technique for uncertainty quantification[6]并利用它来 收集可更直接地解决限制下游任务成功的故障模式的数据。 然后，我们评估持续学习的技术，目的是使用不确定性引导数据微调 VLAand utilize it to collect data that more directly addresses the failure modes limiting downstream task success. We then evaluate techniques for continual learning, with the aim of fine-tuning a VLA with uncertainty-guided data没有without灾难性地忘记以前学过的任务。我们的贡献如下：catastrophic forgetting of previously-learned tasks. Our contributions are as follows:

  1. 1.

    使用 INSIGHT 的自回归 VLA 的主动数据收集框架An active data collection framework for autoregressive VLAs that uses INSIGHT[6]选择不确定的州来引发新的示威并提供最好地利用这些数据的方法。to select uncertain states to prompt new demonstrations and provide the way to best utilize that data.

  2. 2.

    对主动数据收集与被动数据收集的评估表明，从高不确定性状态提供的演示比无引导的演示具有更好的模型性能。An evaluation of active vs passive data collection, showing that demonstrations provided from high-uncertainty states lead to better model performance than unguided demonstrations.

  3. 3.

    在线和离线式数据收集的比较表明，与从所有不确定状态收集数据相比，从部署中的第一个不确定状态收集数据同样有效（因此更高效）。A comparison of online- and offline-style data collection, showing that collecting data from the first uncertain state in a rollout is just as effective (and thus, more efficient) compared to collecting data from all uncertain states.

  4. 4.

    VLA 模型的持续学习技术（基于正则化和基于重放）的应用和分析表明，基于重放的数据混合是目前最可靠的策略。Application and analysis of continual-learning techniques (regularization- and replay-based) for VLA models, showing that replay-based data mixing is currently the most reliable strategy.

  5. 5.

    经验设计课程和开放式研究问题，用于 VLA 中持续、主动的学习。Empirical design lessons and open research questions for continual, active learning in VLAs.

2 相关作品Related Works

机器人策略的主动学习。Active Learning for Robot Policies.主动学习涉及识别状态、轨迹、任务或环境，其中额外的演示将提供最丰富的信息。 DAgger等交互式模仿学习方法Active learning involves identifying states, trajectories, tasks, or environments where additional demonstrations would be most informative. Interactive imitation learning methods such as DAgger[7]和 HG-DAggerand HG-DAgger[8]通过收集对学习政策引起的状态的监督来减少协变量偏移。不确定性引导的主动学习通过仅在政策不确定时询问专家来进一步针对这一过程，例如使用蒙特卡洛退出来选择状态进行监督reduce covariate shift by collecting supervision on states induced by the learned policy. Uncertainty-guided active learning further targets this process by querying the expert only when the policy is uncertain, for example using Monte Carlo dropout to select states for supervision[9]。然而，大多数具有不确定性的聚合方法. However, most uncertainty-aware aggregation methods[10, 11, 12, 13]已经研究了较小的、针对特定任务的政策，通常是在驾驶方面have been studied for smaller, task-specific policies, often in driving[8, 12]或经典的模仿学习环境or classical imitation-learning settings[7]，而不是大型预训练 VLA。, rather than for large pretrained VLAs.

VLA 中的不确定性量化。Uncertainty Quantification in VLAs.先前关于不确定性量化（UQ）的工作已经探索了集成方法Prior work on uncertainty quantification (UQ) has explored ensemble methods[14], 贝叶斯近似, Bayesian approximations[15], 共形预测, conformal prediction[16]，并学习干预或失败预测。例如，知道否, and learned intervention or failure predictors. For example, KnowNo[17]使用共形预测来决定 VLM 规划者何时应寻求帮助，但在高级计划而不是低级 VLA 操作上进行操作。洞察力uses conformal prediction to decide when a VLM planner should ask for help, but operates over high-level plan rather than low-level VLA actions. INSIGHT[6]是自回归 VLA 中 UQ 的推理时间自省方法，它使用令牌级概率特征来预测机器人何时应该寻求帮助。 INSIGHT 从动作解码过程中提取的标记级不确定性特征中学习模型，包括熵、对数概率和基于狄利克雷的任意和认知不确定性估计。is an inference-time introspection method for UQ in autoregressive VLAs that uses token-level probability features to predict when the robot should ask for help. INSIGHT learns a model from token-level uncertainty features extracted during action decoding, including entropy, log-probability, and Dirichlet-based aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty estimates.

持续学习。Continual Learning.持续学习研究模型如何在不存在的情况下获取新知识Continual learning studies how models acquire new knowledge without灾难性遗忘catastrophic forgetting，其中新数据的训练会降低早期任务或分布的性能, where training on new data degrades performance on earlier tasks or distributions[18]。这个问题已经在法学硕士中进行了研究. This issue has been studied in LLMs[19]，表明大型预训练序列模型（例如 VLA）在对新数据进行微调时可能同样容易受到攻击。常见的解决方案包括基于重放的方法，它将新数据与先前数据集中的示例混合在一起, suggesting that large pretrained sequence models such as VLAs may be similarly vulnerable when fine-tuning on new data. Common solutions include replay-based methods, which mix new data with examples from prior datasets[20, 21]，以及基于正则化的方法，限制对先前行为重要的参数的更改。弹性权重合并（EWC）是一种代表性的正则化方法，它使用 Fisher 信息矩阵来惩罚对先前任务重要的参数的更改, and regularization-based methods, which constrain changes to parameters important for prior behavior. Elastic weight consolidation (EWC) is a representative regularization method that uses a Fisher information matrix to penalize changes to parameters important for previous tasks[22].

3 从不确定性引导的数据中实现主动、持续的学习Enabling Active, Continual Learning from Uncertainty-Guided Data

VLA 中的主动学习仍未得到解决和探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种主动、持续的学习范式来微调 VLA。我们专注于自回归 VLA，特别是Active learning in VLAs remains unsolved and under-explored. In this work, we propose an active, continual learning paradigm for fine-tuning VLAs. We focus on autoregressive VLAs, particularlyπ0\pi_{0}-快速-FAST[4]，它将连续的机器人动作标记化并通过下一个标记目标来预测它们。, which tokenizes continuous robot actions and predicts them via a next-token objective.

实现主动学习Toward enabling active learning在 VLA 中，我们利用 INSIGHT 进行不确定性量化in VLAs, we leverage INSIGHT for uncertainty quantification[6]并通过将其“帮助预测”解释为高不确定性状态的代理来利用它，从中收集新的演示。 我们研究不确定性引导的数据收集是否能够实现有效的主动学习，从而引出了我们的第一个研究问题and utilize it by interpreting its “help predictions” as a proxy for high-uncertainty states from which to collect new demonstrations. We study whether uncertainty-guided data collection enables effective active learning, leading to our first research questionRQ-1：RQ-1:与被动的数据收集相比，来自高度不确定性国家的示威活动是否会带来更好的政策绩效？Compared to passive data collection, do demonstrations originating from high-uncertainty states result in better policy performance?

We poseRQ-2：RQ-2:在线式的数据收集就足够了，还是我们需要从所有不确定的状态进行密集的离线收集？Is online-style data collection sufficient, or do we need dense offline collection from all uncertain states?

走向Toward连续的continual主动学习active learning对于 VLA，我们评估for VLAs, we evaluateRQ-3：RQ-3:自回归 VLA 可以微调吗Can autoregressive VLAs be fine-tuned仅only关于新收集的恢复数据？这与 RQ-1 和 2 假设的数据集聚合形成鲜明对比，RQ-1 和 2 结合了机器人之前的数据集和新的不确定性引导数据。 最后，我们应用和评估持续学习的标准技术来解决on newly collected recovery data? This is in contrast to the dataset aggregation assumed for RQ-1&2, which combine the robot’s previous dataset and the new uncertainty-guided data. Finally, we apply and evaluate standard techniques for continual learning to addressRQ-4：RQ-4:数据重放和/或正则化方法是否可以减轻灾难性遗忘，同时仍然能够适应新的训练数据？Do data replay and/or regularization methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting while still enabling adaptation to new training data?

3.2 持续学习策略Continual Learning Strategies

基于重放的数据混合。Replay-based data mixtures.让Let𝒟new\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{new}}表示新收集的恢复数据集（denote the newly collected recovery dataset (either𝒟offline\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{offline}}, 𝒟online\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{online}}, 或, or𝒟passive\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{passive}}）。 我们比较仅新的微调). We compare new-only fine-tuning on𝒟new\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{new}}, 完整重播, full replay on𝒟old∪𝒟new\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{old}}\cup\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{new}}, LIBERO-10 重播, LIBERO-10 replay on𝒟LIBERO10∪𝒟new\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{LIBERO10}}\cup\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{new}}，并有针对性地重播, and targeted replay on𝒟collected​tasks∪𝒟new\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{collected\ tasks}}\cup\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{new}}。收集任务是指被确定为低准确度并用于基于主动学习的数据收集的任务。这些混合物测试单独恢复数据是否足够，是否需要完整的先前数据重放，以及仅限于目标任务的重放是否保留未收集的任务。. Colllected tasks refer to the tasks determined to have low accuracy and used in active learning based data collection. These mixtures test whether recovery data alone is sufficient, whether full prior-data replay is necessary, and whether replay restricted to targeted tasks preserves non-collected tasks.

When task distribution and data volume are controlled, demonstrations from high-uncertainty states provide more useful supervision than demonstrations from task initial states. AppendixB报告了强洞察力和弱洞察力的旧规范化主动与被动比较。这些运行显示出更温和的改进，与作为稳定约束的旧标准化统计数据一致，可以保留先前的行为，但限制对恢复数据分布的适应。这促使我们在仅新实验中使用旧的归一化统计数据，在保守设置下测试仅恢复数据的适应。reports old-normalization active-versus-passive comparisons for both Strong and Weak INSIGHT. These runs show more muted improvement, consistent with old normalization statistics acting as a stabilizing constraint that can preserve prior behavior but limit adaptation to the recovery-data distribution. 6 实验2：在线与离线恢复收集Experiment 2: Online vs. Offline Recovery Collection

我们解决We addressRQ-2：RQ-2:从第一个高不确定性状态进行在线式收集是否足够，或者是否有必要从所有高不确定性状态进行离线收集？我们使用以下方法比较性能is online-style collection from the first high-uncertainty state sufficient, or is offline collection from all high-uncertainty states necessary? We compare performance using在线online vs 离线offline数据集。两个数据集均由 Strong INSIGHT 提供信息，并使用完整的重播缓冲区以及标准 CE 损失和 LR 时间表。datasets. Both datasets are informed by Strong INSIGHT, and use a full replay buffer and the standard CE loss and LR schedule.

结果：Results:图Figure3比较在线和离线恢复收集。在线收款在最佳检查点的总体成功率达到 72.4%，而线下收款达到 68.4%。两种方法的采集任务性能几乎相同，在线采集达到49.2%，离线采集达到48.4%。总体差异无统计学意义（compares online and offline recovery collection. Online collection reaches 72.4% overall success at its best checkpoint, while offline collection reaches 68.4%. The two methods achieve nearly identical collected-task performance, with online collection reaching 49.2% and offline collection reaching 48.4%. The overall difference is not statistically significant (p=0.1659p=0.1659).

讨论：Discussion:我们将此解释为示范效率结果，而不是严格的优越性。在线收集可达到相当的性能，同时需要更少的恢复演示。这表明第一个可靠的高不确定性状态可能标志着推出开始偏离成功行为的点，因此该状态的纠正性演示可以监督不确定状态和任务的其余部分。密集的离线收集增加了更多的数据，但这些额外的状态并没有转化为相应更好的适应。We interpret this as a demonstration-efficiency result rather than strict superiority. Online collection reaches comparable performance while requiring fewer recovery demonstrations. This suggests that the first reliable high-uncertainty state may mark the point where the rollout begins to diverge from successful behavior, so a corrective demonstration from that state can supervise both the uncertain state and the remainder of the task. Dense offline collection adds more data, but those additional states do not translate into proportionally better adaptation.

7 实验3：仅新建微调Experiment 3: New-Only Fine-Tuning

我们解决We addressRQ-3：RQ-3:自回归 VLA 是否可以仅根据新收集的恢复数据进行微调？我们比较微调后的性能can autoregressive VLAs be fine-tuned only on newly collected recovery data? We compare performance after fine-tuning on完整重播full replay数据对比data vs仅限新new-only数据。使用Strong INSIGHT online、Strong INSIGHT离线和Weak INSIGHT online收集新数据。我们重用原始 LIBERO 数据集中的旧标准化统计数据作为正则化器进行新训练：旧规范部分限制了分布变化，因此在此设置下的崩溃提供了更有力的证据，表明仅恢复数据是不够的。data. New data is collected using Strong INSIGHT online, Strong INSIGHT offline, and Weak INSIGHT online. We reuse old normalization statistics from the original LIBERO dataset for new-only training as a regularizer: old norms partially constrain distribution shift, so collapse under this setting provides stronger evidence that recovery data alone is insufficient.

结果：Results:图Figure4表明仅新的微调会导致严重的遗忘。在强和弱 INSIGHT 恢复数据集中，随着训练的进展，保留任务性能会崩溃，总体成功率远远低于原始基线。相比之下，基于重放的全混合训练可以保留保留任务的性能，同时改进收集的任务。例如，最好的 Strong INSIGHT 在线新检查点仅达到 28.4% 的总体成功率，其中收集任务成功率为 0.4%，保留任务成功率为 56.4%。相应的基于重放的在线模型总体成功率为 72.4%，其中收集任务成功率为 49.2%，保留任务成功率为 95.6%。shows that new-only fine-tuning causes severe forgetting. Across Strong and Weak INSIGHT recovery datasets, retained-task performance collapses as training progresses and overall success falls far below the original baseline. In contrast, replay-based all-mix training preserves retained-task performance while improving collected tasks. For example, the best Strong INSIGHT online new-only checkpoint reaches only 28.4% overall success, with 0.4% collected-task success and 56.4% retained-task success. The corresponding replay-based online model reaches 72.4% overall success, with 49.2% collected-task success and 95.6% retained-task success.

讨论：Discussion:复苏示范之所以能提供丰富的信息，正是因为它们关注的是困难的、政策引发的状态，但这也使得数据集的分布范围狭窄。仅新的微调无法提供足够的覆盖范围来保留原始策略已经表现良好的行为。因此，VLA 的主动学习不能简化为选择高价值状态；适应程序还必须保留先前的能力。Recovery demonstrations are informative precisely because they focus on difficult, policy-induced states, but this also makes the dataset distributionally narrow. New-only fine-tuning does not provide enough coverage to preserve behaviors that the original policy already performs well. Thus, active learning for VLAs cannot be reduced to selecting high-value states; the adaptation procedure must also preserve prior competence.

讨论：Discussion:低学习率和 EWC 只能解决部分主动持续学习问题。弱约束允许更多的适应，但存在遗忘的风险，而强约束保留保留任务行为，但抑制从恢复演示中学习有用的知识。在我们的设置中，重放比单独的参数正则化提供了更强的稳定性-可塑性权衡。Low learning rates and EWC solve only part of the active continual-learning problem. Weak constraints allow more adaptation but risk forgetting, while strong constraints preserve retained-task behavior but suppress useful learning from recovery demonstrations. In our setting, replay provides a stronger stability-plasticity tradeoff than parameter regularization alone.

结果：Results:图Figure6结果表明，完整重放和 LIBERO-10 重放都保持了强大的保留任务性能，同时改进了收集的任务。 LIBERO-10 重放的总体成功率达到 68.6%，接近完整重放所达到的 72.4%；这种差异并不显着（shows that full replay and LIBERO-10 replay both maintain strong retained-task performance while improving collected tasks. LIBERO-10 replay reaches 68.6% overall success, close to the 72.4% achieved by full replay; this difference is not significant (p=0.1877p=0.1877）。相比之下，与 LIBERO-10 重放相比，有针对性的重放总体成功率达到 63.2%，并且显着降低了保留任务性能，从 90.0% 下降到 83.6% 保留任务成功率（). 图Figure7进一步测试EWC能否稳定定向回放。它并不能始终如一地解决保留问题：一些变体在训练早期短暂地保留了性能，但许多变体后来大幅下降。因此，当重播覆盖范围太窄时，参数正则化无法可靠地补偿丢失的保留任务数据。further tests whether EWC can stabilize targeted replay. It does not consistently solve the retention problem: some variants briefly preserve performance early in training, but many later degrade substantially. Thus, when replay coverage is too narrow, parameter regularization cannot reliably compensate for missing retained-task data.

讨论：Discussion:重播不一定需要包含完整的原始数据集，但它必须涵盖应保留的行为。将重放限制为 LIBERO-10 保留了完整重放的大部分优势，而有针对性的重放会偏向于收集任务的适应，并导致非收集任务的性能下降。Replay does not necessarily need to include the full original dataset, but it must cover the behaviors that should be retained. Restricting replay to LIBERO-10 preserves most of the benefit of full replay, while targeted replay biases adaptation toward the collected tasks and allows non-collected task performance to degrade.

10 总结与结论Summary and Conclusion

我们通过使用 INSIGHT 预测来识别高不确定性状态并从这些状态收集恢复演示，研究了自回归 VLA 的主动持续学习。通过实验，出现了五项发现。首先，在强洞察力和弱洞察力设置中，高不确定性恢复演示比匹配的被动启动状态演示提供更多信息。其次，在线恢复收集比离线收集更具演示效率：尽管需要更多演示，但密集的离线收集并不能提供统计上显着的整体优势。第三，仅恢复数据不足以进行微调；即使在旧的标准化统计数据下，仅新的训练也会导致灾难性的遗忘，这部分限制了分布变化。第四，低学习率和 EWC 减少了遗忘，但暴露了稳定性与可塑性的权衡，以减少适应为代价保留了旧的行为。第五，基于重放的混合提供了最强大的整体解决方案，但重放覆盖范围很重要：LIBERO-10 重放接近完全重放，而有针对性的重放无法保持保留任务性能。We studied active continual learning for autoregressive VLAs by using INSIGHT predictions to identify high-uncertainty, states and collect recovery demonstrations from those states. Across experiments, five findings emerge. First, high-uncertainty recovery demonstrations are more informative than matched passive start-state demonstrations in both the Strong INSIGHT and the Weak INSIGHT settings. Second, online recovery collection is more demonstration-efficient than offline collection: dense offline collection does not provide a statistically significant overall advantage despite requiring more demonstrations. Third, recovery data alone is insufficient for fine-tuning; new-only training causes catastrophic forgetting even under old normalization statistics, which partially constrain distribution shift. Fourth, low learning rates and EWC reduce forgetting but expose a stability-plasticity tradeoff, preserving old behavior at the cost of reduced adaptation. Fifth, replay-based mixing provides the strongest overall solution, but replay coverage matters: LIBERO-10 replay approaches full replay, while targeted replay fails to preserve retained-task performance.

总之，这些结果支持了这样一个中心论点：VLA 的主动学习必须被表述为主动持续学习，机器人不仅能够检测到它们何时需要帮助，而且还利用这些时刻来收集信息丰富的经验并在不消除先前技能的情况下将其整合起来。 INSIGHT 类型的不确定性预测器可以识别恢复收集的信息状态，但生成的数据很窄且分布发生变化。因此，有效的适应需要有针对性的数据收集和保留先前学到的行为的机制。Together, these results support the central claim that active learning for VLAs must be formulated as active continual learning, where robots not only detect when they need help, but also use those moments to collect informative experience and integrate it without erasing prior skills. INSIGHT-style uncertainty predictors identify informative states for recovery collection, but the resulting data is narrow and distribution-shifted. Effective adaptation therefore requires both targeted data collection and mechanisms for preserving previously learned behaviors.

11 局限性Limitations

我们的研究有几个局限性。首先，所有实验均在 LIBERO-10 模拟中进行。这使得能够对主动数据收集和持续适应进行受控评估，但物理部署会引入传感器噪声、执行可变性、安全限制、不完美的重置和更高的演示成本。我们的恢复收集过程还假设可以在高不确定性的中间状态下访问模拟器重置；在真实的机器人上，类似的数据可能需要运行时的人工干预或自然达到的故障相邻状态的演示。因此，在线设置比所有高不确定性状态的离线收集更接近部署，但两者都抽象了现实世界的收集成本。其次，我们的结果取决于帮助预测器​​的质量。 INSIGHT 可能会产生误报（浪费演示）和误报（错过有用的恢复状态）；未来的工作应该研究更好的校准和对风险更加敏感的不确定性估计。第三，我们在一个基准上评估一个自回归 VLA 系列。其他 VLA 架构，尤其是基于扩散或混合动作头，可能需要不同的不确定性信号和恢复状态选择机制。第四，我们的持续学习方法很简单：重播、低学习率微调和 EWC。更复杂的方法，如 LoRA、适配器、选择性冻结、梯度投影、数据重新加权、排演缓冲区或蒸馏，可能会改善稳定性与可塑性的权衡。最后，我们主要关注任务的成功；未来的评估还应衡量干预成本、演示次数、恢复时间、行动流畅性、安全违规、不确定性校准和重复的主动学习周期。Our study has several limitations. First, all experiments are in LIBERO-10 simulation. This enables controlled evaluation of active data collection and continual adaptation, but physical deployment introduces sensor noise, execution variability, safety constraints, imperfect resets, and higher demonstration costs. Our recovery-collection procedure also assumes access to simulator resets at high-uncertainty intermediate states; on real robots, analogous data would likely require runtime human intervention or demonstrations from naturally reached failure-adjacent states. Thus, the online setting is closer to deployment than offline collection from all high-uncertainty states, but both abstract away real-world collection costs. Second, our results depend on the quality of the help predictor. INSIGHT can produce false positives, which waste demonstrations, and false negatives, which miss useful recovery states; future work should study better calibrated and more risk-sensitive uncertainty estimates. Third, we evaluate one autoregressive VLA family on one benchmark. Other VLA architectures, especially diffusion-based or hybrid action heads, may require different uncertainty signals and recovery-state selection mechanisms. Fourth, our continual-learning methods are simple: replay, low-learning-rate fine-tuning, and EWC. More sophisticated methods such as LoRA, adapters, selective freezing, gradient projection, data reweighting, rehearsal buffers, or distillation may improve the stability-plasticity tradeoff. Finally, we focus primarily on task success; future evaluations should also measure intervention cost, demonstration count, recovery length, action smoothness, safety violations, uncertainty calibration, and repeated active-learning cycles.

附录AAppendix A计算基础设施Compute Infrastructure

所有模型均在使用 NVIDIA H200 GPU 的机构高性能计算集群上进行训练。大多数评估也在同一集群上运行，并在 NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 工作站上进行了一些额外的本地测试。该项目总共使用了大约 2,154 H200 GPU 小时的集群计算。All models were trained on an institutional high-performance computing cluster using NVIDIA H200 GPUs. Most evaluations were also run on the same cluster, with some additional local testing on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada workstation. In total, the project used approximately 2,154 H200 GPU-hours of cluster compute.

附录BAppendix B标准化-统计消融Normalization-Statistics Ablations

主要的主动与被动比较使用新的归一化统计数据，该统计数据更好地匹配聚合重放加恢复数据集的状态和动作分布。在这里，我们使用旧的标准化统计数据报告了额外的主动与被动比较。这些运行很有用，因为旧的标准化统计数据部分限制了针对原始数据分布的微调策略。因此，旧的标准化可以像隐式正则化器一样：它可以帮助保留先前的行为，但它也可以限制对新收集的恢复演示的适应。The main active-versus-passive comparison uses new normalization statistics, which better match the state and action distribution of the aggregated replay-plus-recovery dataset. Here, we report additional active-versus-passive comparisons using old normalization statistics. These runs are useful because old normalization statistics partially constrain the fine-tuned policy toward the original data distribution. As a result, old normalization can act like an implicit regularizer: it can help preserve prior behavior, but it can also limit adaptation to the newly collected recovery demonstrations.

图Figure8显示 Strong INSIGHT 主动与被动与旧标准化统计数据的比较。与图中主要新标准化结果相比shows the Strong INSIGHT active-versus-passive comparison with old normalization statistics. Compared to the main new-normalization result in Figure2，在线恢复收集的改善更加微弱。这支持了这样的解释：旧的归一化统计数据稳定了模型，但降低了利用恢复数据所需的可塑性。, the improvement from online recovery collection is more muted. This supports the interpretation that old normalization statistics stabilize the model but reduce the plasticity needed to exploit recovery data.

图Figure9显示了使用 Wea​​k INSIGHT 进行的相同旧归一化比较。弱 INSIGHT 提供了补充的域内或 LIBERO 对齐的帮助信号，而强 INSIGHT 是主论文中使用的更清晰的传输设置。旧标准化的弱结果遵循相同的定性模式：恢复数据可以提高收集任务的性能，但旧标准化限制了适应的幅度。shows the same old-normalization comparison using Weak INSIGHT. Weak INSIGHT provides a complementary in-domain or LIBERO-aligned help signal, while Strong INSIGHT is the cleaner transfer setting used in the main paper. The old-normalization weak result follows the same qualitative pattern: recovery data can improve collected-task performance, but old normalization limits the magnitude of adaptation.

这些消融也促使我们在新的微调实验中使用旧的归一化统计数据。由于旧的标准化是一种保守的稳定选择，旧标准化下的灾难性遗忘提供了更有力的证据，表明仅恢复数据不足以实现稳定适应。These ablations also motivate our use of old normalization statistics in the new-only fine-tuning experiments. Since old normalization acts as a conservative stabilizing choice, catastrophic forgetting under old normalization provides stronger evidence that recovery data alone is insufficient for stable adaptation.

附录CAppendix C额外的 EWC 扫描Additional EWC Sweeps

图Figure10使用低学习率报告完整的 EWC 系数扫描reports the full EWC coefficient sweep using the low learning rateα=2.5×10−8\alpha=2.5\times 10^{-8}。在系数中，更强的正则化通常可以提高保留率，但收集任务的性能仍然有限，并且总体成功与基于重放的混合不匹配。图. Across coefficients, stronger regularization generally improves retention, but collected-task performance remains limited and overall success does not match replay-based mixing. Figure11使用过滤的 Fisher 估计报告相应的扫描。过滤 Fisher 参考数据会改变详细的训练动态，但不会消除主论文中观察到的稳定性-可塑性权衡。reports the corresponding sweep using filtered Fisher estimates. Filtering the Fisher reference data changes the detailed training dynamics, but does not remove the stability-plasticity tradeoff observed in the main paper.
